title: Higgins Building Group
summary: A photography-led website rebuild for a custom luxury home builder.
tagline: A full website rebuild for an established Hickory, North Carolina builder of custom luxury homes, designed so the company's own project photography carries the experience.
role: Led discovery, information architecture, design, development, stakeholder review, and deployment through Higgins Digital.
problem: Higgins Building Group had years of finished custom homes and the photography to prove it, but the old site showed that work at thumbnail scale inside a dated layout. The strongest asset the business owned was the thing visitors saw least.
contribution: Company leadership commissioned the rebuild, and I ran it independently through Higgins Digital: stakeholder discovery, a content audit, information architecture, design, development, quality assurance, a revision round worked directly from the owner's change list, and the production deployment.
solution: The new site lets the homes do the selling. Project photography runs full width, a filterable portfolio opens each photo in a lightbox, a five-stage process page explains how a build works, and a "Begin a conversation" path sits in the header on every page.
solutionPoints: Rebuilt structure: home, about, portfolio, process, properties, testimonials, and contact.
An optimized image library served at the right size for each device.
A navy-and-gold design system drawn from the company's logo, with a mobile-first layout.
Protected contact and early-notice forms, search-ready metadata, and accessibility and reduced-motion passes.

architecture.summary: A photo pipeline feeds every page, and inquiries go straight to the company.

decisions.title: Full-width photography without the weight.
decisions.text: Every photo is prepared for the web and served at the size each device needs, so the work looks its best on a phone without a slow page.

decisions.title: Organize around how homeowners search.
decisions.text: Navigation follows the questions a prospective client asks: what have they built, how does a build work, and how do I start.

decisions.title: Stop spam quietly.
decisions.text: Forms are protected from abuse without making real homeowners solve a puzzle.

outcomes: The production site at higginsbuildinggroup.com presents the company's homes, process, and contact paths in a modern responsive experience. In the owner's words on the public project page: "Davis took our old website and turned it into something that finally feels like Higgins Building Group."
limits: Performance scores and lead metrics are not reported here because there is no dated measurement artifact to support them.
lessons: A client redesign starts with the company's actual strengths and the questions its customers need answered.
